clauses.quote: U officials shall have the right to investigate grievances and engage in other appropriate activities throughout the school system at times that do not interfere with the instructional program.
The Supervisor shall afford full cooperation in such investigations and activities.
WTU officials, upon arrival at a School, shall inform the Supervisor or her/his designee of their presence
and shall abide by the School’s regular security procedures.

DCPS agrees to release, during normal school hours, a reasonable number of Teachers, upon request of the WTU President, for the purpose of serving on mutually agreed upon committees and participating in mutually agreed upon activities.

Whenever Teachers are mutually scheduled by the parties to participate during working hours in conferences or meetings or in negotiations respecting the collective bargaining agreement, they shall suffer no loss in pay.

To plan for, study and to participate in mutually established committees relating to the collective bargaining agreement and educational reform as proposed by DCPS, DCPS agrees to release during the year and during working hours a reasonable number of Teachers upon request of the WTU President.
The President shall submit to the Chancellor for approval the names of WTU Teachers proposed for release in accordance with a predetermined schedule at least three (3) days prior to any meeting.
All schools shall establish a Local School Restructuring Team (LSRT)
and the Team shall operate under guidelines established in the Planning Guide for LSRTs to be mutually developed by DCPS and the WTU.
The School Chapter Advisory Council shall receive all recommendations or matters generated by the LSRT.
Decisions reached by the LSRT shall not change or supersede any contractual agreement, city regulations, or DCPS policies or procedures.
The LSRT and the principal shall collaborate to determine the composition of the School Improvement Team (SIT).
